name: Paya Lebar West
summary: West of Paya Lebar toward Geylang / Guillemard edges — EWL/CCL interchange gravity with office-edge living and denser weekend texture.
body: Paya Lebar West is the shortlist when dual-line interchange gravity and office-edge convenience matter more than quiet estate parks. The pocket sits west of Paya Lebar toward Geylang / Guillemard edges; housing mixes mid-age condos, walk-ups, and selective HDB. Expats land here for car-light hops to CBD / Bugis and ActiveSG catchment without Marina Bay premiums. Watch-outs: weekend mall and food crowds, high-rise gondola notice calendars, and confusing Paya Lebar vs Paya Lebar West shortlists. Compare with Eunos North for denser EWL food living, Kaki Bukit Fringe for quieter DTL edges, and Guillemard when stadium-adjacent energy wins.
